convertibility_reason: Grid strategy with martingale volume scaling (MathPow(2,i)*Lots) and heavy pending order management (BuyLimit/SellLimit). The core logic relies on placing multiple pending orders at grid intervals, which requires tick-level execution and is inherently a broker-dependent grid/martingale system unsuitable for straightforward Python conversion.

derived_values.formula: InpLimit * digits_adjust (digits_adjust=10 if 3/5 digit symbol, else 1)

derived_values.formula: InpLockDown * digits_adjust (digits_adjust=10 if 3/5 digit symbol, else 1)

derived_values.name: Base lot size from balance
derived_values.used_by: Initial market order and grid order sizing

other_exits: Close all positions and delete all pending orders when total profit across all positions >= Amount input (default 40)
Break-even stop loss: when position profit in points exceeds ExtLockDown (default 0 = disabled), move SL to entry price +/- 1 point

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Base lot = round(Balance/100)/1000. Grid levels 1-4 use volume = 2^i * base_lot. Each level placed at grid spacing ExtGrid points away from entry.

custom_logic_notes: Grid/martingale EA: opens a market order when price is far enough from recent high/low, then places 4 pending limit orders at grid intervals with doubling volume (2x, 4x, 8x, 16x base lot). All positions close when cumulative profit reaches 'Amount' threshold. Break-even SL is optionally applied after ExtLockDown points of profit. CloseAll also deletes all pending orders. Position gate is no_position (only opens new grid when flat). The IsTradeAllowed function has a duplicate check for TERMINAL_TRADE_ALLOWED (lines 230 and 235).
python_conversion_notes: Grid/martingale strategy with pending order management is fundamentally mt5_only. The 4-level pending order grid with volume doubling (2^i scaling), price-based grid spacing, and cumulative profit-based close-all logic would require a custom order book simulation in Python. The break-even SL modification adds complexity. Pending order lifecycle management (placement, deletion on close-all, fill tracking) must be fully simulated. Tick data is essential for backtesting due to intrabar grid fill assumptions. The digit adjustment logic (multiplying by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be preserved. Not recommended for auto-conversion due to grid+martingale combo requiring broker-level execution simulation.
